_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Tenth scheduled run, and the first since the 429 backoff was added: every site that was rate-limited yesterday served on the first attempt, so the run needed a single pass. 13 of 19 URLs served a catalog, the same coverage as the past three days. No new matches: every product title matching a chart name on a reachable site already has a case. No listing classified cut-roses-only, so that register stays empty. Catalog movement since 2026-09-24: Kisaki Plant 316->317, Springland Flowers 115->116, and Hillside Rose Farm 155->154 -- a listing was removed there, but not one Rose Watch has a case for, since all five of its cases re-verified present. 285 of 321 cases re-verified. The 36 unchecked are Your Roses' 33 and Flower Meadow Dream's 3 -- unchecked, not clean. Your Roses' root answered 200 again today after 403 yesterday; its catalog has been refused every day without exception.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.

Not reached. Both www.myroseworld.com and myroseworld.com were refused by this environment's egress proxy at the CONNECT stage, so the request never reached the seller's server. This is our own network policy, not a block by the site. Unchanged since 2026-09-16. The site's 3 existing cases (MYROSEWORL-001..003) could not be re-verified and keep their 2026-09-16 Last Verified date.
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.
Served cleanly on the apex host; 755 products, unchanged. www.molarose.com stays refused by the egress proxy, which costs nothing since the crawler tries both host forms.

STILL BLOCKED, eight days on (first seen 2026-09-18), and the root flipped a third time: it answers HTTP 200 again today, after 403 yesterday and 200 on 2026-09-21 through 2026-09-23. The catalog has never once opened -- 403 from the seller's LiteSpeed/Hostinger firewall on /wp-json/wp/v2/product, 404 on the Shopify feed path, every single day. The CONNECT still succeeds, so this remains the site refusing us, not our egress proxy. No attempt was made to work around it. Its 33 cases (YOURROSES-001..033) still hold their 2026-09-17 Last Verified date -- eight days unverified, reported as unchecked and never as clean. The root now reads as noise rather than signal: it has moved three times while the catalog rule has not moved at all. Due back to the user with options on Monday 2026-09-28.

screenshot_limitation: Still no case has a screenshot on file -- same network-proxy limitation as prior runs (headless Chromium cannot complete a connection through this environment's egress proxy). Explained to the user in chat on 2026-09-14; awaiting their choice of approach (manual capture vs. Wayback Machine vs. environment-level fix).
